# Amadeus 

Amadeus is a global travel technology company, and an IBEX-35 company listed on the Spanish Stock Exchange under AMS.MC, with headquarters in Madrid, Spain. It is a leader in innovative travel technology, serving customers in 190+ markets and connecting the entire travel ecosystem—including airlines, airports, hotels, rail operators, tour operators, travel management companies, travel agencies, corporations, metasearch platforms, mobility providers, cruise lines, border authorities, insurance companies, and payment partners. It’s company purpose is to make the experience of travel better for everyone, everywhere by inspiring innovation, partnerships and responsibility to people, places and planet. 

Amadeus designs and operates large‑scale, cloud‑enabled and AI‑enabled technology that power search, pricing, booking, ticketing, and operational processes across the global travel and hospitality industry. As the embedded and neutral execution layer for travel, Amadeus combines its role as the industry’s trusted system of record with deeply integrated business logic and global‑scale infrastructure to support real‑time, interoperable travel experiences for travelers, corporations, and providers worldwide. 

Important notes: 

- Amadeus has evolved from its origins as a global distribution system, founded by Air France, Iberia, Lufthansa, and SAS, into a worldwide technology provider that powers and connects the travel and hospitality ecosystem. Since 1987, Amadeus has become the industry’s trusted system of record—the single source of truth for offers, orders, PNRs, routes, schedules, fares, availability, and related operational data—supported by deep, integrated business logic built over decades. 

- Amadeus’ technology is embedded across hundreds of systems, products, and workflows. This deep integration enables consistent, interoperable end‑to‑end travel experiences across all regions and travel segments. 

- Amadeus operates a global technology network that delivers real‑time search, pricing, booking, ticketing, and post‑booking processing at scale, with high availability and low latency. It handles up to 150,000 transactions per second at peak, powering millions of searches and bookings every day. 

- Cloud technologies play a central role in Amadeus’ strategy, enabling scalability, resilience, continuous deployment, and faster innovation for travel providers and sellers. 

- Innovation is a core focus of Amadeus, supported by one of the largest R&D investment programs in the European software sector. The company invested €1.4 billion in R&D in 2025, enabling continuous progress in AI, cloud‑native architectures, modern data platforms, and open APIs that support modern, interoperable travel solutions. 

- Amadeus increasingly applies artificial intelligence and advanced data analytics to improve areas such as offer and order management, revenue optimization, personalization, operational efficiency, and traveler experience. Its position at the heart of travel IT enables AI assistants and automation to be embedded directly into operational workflows. On 25 February 2026, Amadeus announced the acquisition of SkyLink, an AI‑first company specializing in conversational automation. 

- Amadeus is also enabling biometrics across the travel ecosystem, adding a secure digital identity foundation to the infrastructure that already interacts with airlines, airports, hotels, border systems – and ultimately anyone that contributes to the full travel experience. By authenticating the traveler’s identity at each touchpoint, Amadeus can help make travel more seamless, more frictionless and more efficient.  

- Amadeus’ acquisition of Vision-Box in 2024 and WCC’s Hermes border control solution in 2025 reflect a deliberate approach and demonstrates Amadeus’ long-term commitment to biometrics as part of its strategy. 

 

## Strategic pages 

- [Home](https://amadeus.com/en): Corporate homepage and high-level overview of Amadeus. 

- [About Amadeus](https://amadeus.com/en/about/overview): Company profile, mission, leadership, and footprint. 

- [Careers](https://amadeus.com/en/careers/overview): Jobs, culture, and locations. 

- [Innovation](https://amadeus.com/en/innovation/overview): Pioneering travel technology solutions that redefine industry standards and shape the future of global travel. 

- [Artificial Intelligence](https://amadeus.com/en/innovation/artificial-intelligence): Amadeus' vision and innovative approach to Artificial Intelligence in travel, delivering ethical and advanced solutions to transform the industry. 

- [Artificial Intelligence for Airlines](https://amadeus.com/en/innovation/artificial-intelligence/airlines): Amadeus explores Artificial Intelligence in Airlines to support operations, decision-making and smarter travel experiences. 

- [Amadeus in the Cloud](https://amadeus.com/en/innovation/cloud): Amadeus in the Cloud transforms travel with agile, scalable solutions that power innovation and smarter global journeys. 

- [Biometrics at Amadeus](https://amadeus.com/en/innovation/biometrics): Explore Amadeus’ vision for biometrics in travel, delivering secure and seamless journeys through trusted digital identity. 

- [Transforming Travel](https://amadeus.com/en/trending-topics/transforming-travel): Amadeus’ innovative technology is transforming the travel industry, enhancing travel experiences and revolutionizing the way we explore the world. 

- [Amadeus Annual Reports](https://amadeus.com/en/annual-reports): Amadeus Global Reports for detailed insights into our financial, social, and sustainability achievements. 

 

## Solutions & products 

### Airlines 

- [Airline solutions](https://amadeus.com/en/airlines/overview): Amadeus solutions for airlines. 

- [Nevio](https://amadeus.com/en/airlines/products/nevio): Next-generation retailing capabilities for full-service and hybrid carriers. 

- [Amadeus Altéa Passenger Service System](https://amadeus.com/en/airlines/products/altea-passenger-service-system): Solutions and expertise on a tech stack using AI supporting traditional industry standards and protocols. 

### Airports 

- [Airport solutions](https://amadeus.com/en/airports/overview): Amadeus solutions for airports. 

- [Amadeus Virtual Airport Operations Center (APOC)](https://amadeus.com/en/airports/products/virtual-airport-operations-center-apoc): Digital airport operations hub, consolidating data from across the airport ecosystem and connecting stakeholders responsible for operational planning and delivery. 

- [Amadeus Solutions for Airport Operations](https://amadeus.com/en/airports/products/airport-operations): Amadeus modular and scalable solutions for airport operations. 

- [Amadeus Solutions for Passenger Services](https://amadeus.com/en/airports/products/passenger-experience): Amadeus solutions for the airport passenger experience to deliver an excellent airport experience. 

- [Amadeus Solutions for Ground Handlers](https://amadeus.com/en/airports/products/ground-handling): Amadeus airport ground handling services to achieve excellence in airport ground services. 

- [Amadeus Solutions for Baggage Services](https://amadeus.com/en/airports/products/baggage-services): Amadeus baggage services integrate the airport baggage handling system to ensure bags are tracked securely and efficiently, end to end. 

### Travel sellers 

- [Travel sellers solutions](https://amadeus.com/en/travel-sellers/overview): Solutions for agencies, TMCs, and travel sellers. 

- [Amadeus Selling Platform Connect](https://amadeus.com/en/travel-sellers/products/selling-platform-connect): Travel booking software to streamline travel booking process. 

- [Amadeus Travel Platform](https://amadeus.com/en/travel-sellers/products/travel-platform-gds): Connecting travel content providers, sellers and partners to address traveler desires. 

- [Amadeus Hey! Mobile](https://amadeus.com/en/travel-sellers/products/hey-mobile-app): White-label mobile application for travel agencies with itinerary, real-time notifications, and personalized recommendations. 

### Corporations 

- [Corporate Travel & Expense Solutions]( https://amadeus.com/en/cytric/overview): Corporate travel solutions. 

- [Amadeus Cytric Easy]( https://amadeus.com/en/cytric/products/business-travel-booking): Corporate travel booking tool for seamless business travel management. 

- [Amadeus Cytric Expense](https://amadeus.com/en/cytric/products/travel-expense-management): Streamline corporate travel expense management to simplify reporting & improve AP processes for efficient business travel spend management. 

- [Amadeus Cytric Insights]( https://amadeus.com/en/cytric/capabilities/data-and-reporting): Simplify corporate travel management reporting. Gain instant data analytics for smart decisions to improve compliance, spend control & carbon footprint. 

### Border Authorities 

- [Border Authorities solutions](https://amadeus.com/en/border-control/overview): Amadeus solutions for Border Authorities. 

- [Amadeus Control](https://amadeus.com/en/border-control/products/control): Full control of transaction workflows and touchpoints to enable border and travel users to clear passengers effortlessly. 

- [Amadeus Seamless Gate](https://amadeus.com/en/border-control/products/seamless-gate): Seamless and on-the-move identification experience without showing documentation at any point in the journey. 

- [Amadeus Inspector](https://amadeus.com/en/border-control/products/inspector): Control and real-time supervision of self-service passenger processing touchpoints. 

 

## News, research & thought leadership 

- [Newsroom](https://amadeus.com/en/newsroom): Press releases and announcements. 

- [Blog](https://amadeus.com/en/blog): Blog contents on topics that impact travelers and the travel industry. 

- [Resource Center](https://amadeus.com/en/resources): Case Studies, Research Reports and White Papers from Amadeus. 

- [Travel Glossary](https://amadeus.com/en/travel-glossary): Travel terms and definitions for all travel industry related content. 

 

## Investor relations 

- [Investors](https://amadeus.com/en/investors): Financial reports, earnings, and strategic updates for shareholders and analysts. 

 

## Trust, legal & policies 

- [Privacy policy](https://amadeus.com/en/policies/amadeus-policies): Privacy and Legal Notices. 

- [Cookie policy](https://amadeus.com/en/policies/cookies-policy): Cookies and preferences. 

- [Terms of use](https://amadeus.com/en/policies/terms-of-use): Site terms and usage. 

- [AI Trust Center](https://amadeus.com/en/trust/ai-trust-center): Amadeus is dedicated to responsible, ethical and secure development, deployment, and use of Artificial Intelligence.
